item.title: Young Workers See Job Losses in AI-Exposed Roles, Dallas Fed Says
item.description: A new report from the Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas finds employment among young workers has declined in occupations most exposed to artificial intelligence.

item.title: Theorem Ranch Acquires Teton Ridge's T9 Ranch
item.description: The Parker County Western performance property was listed for $45 million and will become a training and performance institute under Theorem Ranch’s ownership.

item.title: Westlake’s Goosehead Insurance founders buy Nebraska Sandhills ranch for record $56M
item.description: Mark and Robyn Jones, founders of Westlake-based Goosehead Insurance, purchased the 41,000-acre Pawnee Springs Ranch in Nebraska for $56 million, a record-setting sale in the Sandhills region.

item.title: Argonaut Private Equity Sells Fort Worth-Based VoidForm Products to White Cap
item.description: Argonaut Private Equity completes the sale of Fort Worth-based VoidForm Products to White Cap, positioning the concrete-solutions manufacturer for its next phase of growth.

item.title: NRP Group Opens Thrive on Crawford, Mixed-Income Health and Housing Community in Fort Worth
item.description: The 67-unit mixed-income development integrates affordable housing with on-site healthcare services through a partnership with JPS Health Network.

item.title: Women-Owned Stella Jets Takes Private Aviation to Bravo’s 'Real Housewives of Potomac'
item.description: The women-owned private aviation company behind Stella Jets, StellaShAire, and Stella Experiences reaches a national audience with its appearance on Bravo’s “Real Housewives of Potomac.”

item.title: IRS Opens 2026 Filing Season With Mandatory Electronic Payments
item.description: Paper checks are being phased out as the IRS moves nearly all tax payments and refunds online. Here’s how the change affects 2025 tax returns.

item.title: Texas Manufacturing Rebounds in January as Factory Activity Expands
item.description: Texas factory activity expanded solidly in January, with production, orders and employment all improving, according to the Dallas Fed’s latest Manufacturing Outlook Survey.

item.title: City of Fort Worth Names Operations Manager at Convention Center
item.description: Leadership changes elevate Jordan Steffan to operations manager at the Fort Worth Convention Center and place Shanda Cartwright in an interim sales role at Will Rogers Memorial Center.

item.title: Texas Service Sector Expands in January, Dallas Fed Survey Shows
item.description: Revenue growth returned and business outlooks improved, according to the latest Texas Service Sector Outlook Survey.
